nodes.text: The day is done. Ready to transform today's events into tomorrow's growth?
Think of a friction point today. Was it a wall (unpassable) or a hurdle (jumpable)?

options.text: A wall. External factors stopped me.
A hurdle. I could have approached it differently.

nodes.text: Even when the environment builds a wall, you own the response. How will you pivot tomorrow?
When a task got difficult, what was your first instinct?

options.text: To wait for more info or help.
To find a small part I could own immediately.

nodes.text: Ownership starts small. Waiting is a choice to let others hold the wheel.
Did you decide your priorities today, or did your inbox decide them?

options.text: I drove my key tasks forward.

nodes.text: Reaction feels like survival. Proaction feels like victory. Tomorrow, try a 'no-inbox' first hour.
Control established. Now, let's look at the quality of your contribution.
Did you focus on 'doing things right' or 'doing the right things'?

options.text: Just checking boxes and following orders.
Seeking ways to add real value.

nodes.text: Box-checking is safe, but growth lives in the 'extra mile' you define for yourself.
When you hit a gap in your knowledge, what happened?

options.text: I moved on to avoid slowing down.
I paused to learn or research the 'why'.

nodes.text: The things we skip today become the technical debt of our career tomorrow.
Are you finishing today more capable than you were this morning?

options.text: Yes, I mastered a new detail.

nodes.text: Routine is for machines. Mastery is for engineers. Find one new thing to track tomorrow.
Mindset checked. Finally, how far did your impact reach?
Did you actively look for a way to make a teammate's life easier today?

options.text: I was too focused on my own survival.
Yes, I offered help or shared knowledge.

nodes.text: Solo survival is exhausting. Team-based growth is sustainable.
Did you write or build with the 'next person' in mind?

options.text: I just wanted to get it off my plate.
I left it clean and documented.

nodes.text: The mark of an expert is work that doesn't require a question from the person who follows you.
Whose goals did you prioritize today?

options.text: The success of the wider project/user.

nodes.text: Calculating your path profile...
THE VICTOR: You owned your actions, sought growth, and lifted others. You are a leader in the making.
THE SOLO SPECIALIST: You have great ownership and growth, but your radius is narrow. Focus on empathy tomorrow.
THE PASSENGER: Today, you were driven by the world. Tomorrow, take the wheel of your own learning.
Reflection complete. Rest now. Your potential resets at dawn.
